**Top‑selling digital‑download singles (worldwide) – record‑label information**

| Rank | Digital single (artist) | Approx. digital‑download sales* | Record label(s) that released the single |
|------|--------------------------|--------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| **1** | **“Shape of You” – Ed Sheeran** | ~ 41.5 million downloads | **Asylum Records** (U.K.) / **Atlantic Records** (U.S.) – both imprints of **Warner Music Group** |
| **2** | **“Despacito” – Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee feat. Justin Bieber** | ~ 38.5 million downloads | **Universal Music Latin Entertainment** (Luis Fonsi & Daddy Yankee) / **Republic Records** (Justin Bieber version) – both divisions of **Universal Music Group** |
| **3** | **“Uptown Funk” – Mark Ronson feat. Bruno Mars** | ~ 34.5 million downloads | **RCA Records** – a flagship label of **Sony Music Entertainment** |
| **4** | **“Closer” – The Chainsmokers feat. Halsey** | ~ 31.0 million downloads | **Disruptor Records** (the Chainsmokers’ imprint) / **Columbia Records** – both under **Sony Music Entertainment** |
| **5** | **“Thinking Out Loud” – Ed Sheeran** | ~ 27.5 million downloads | **Asylum Records** / **Atlantic Records** – Warner Music Group (same label family as “Shape of You”) |

\*Sales figures are the total **worldwide digital‑download (i‑Tunes/other storefront) units** reported by the *Wikipedia* article **“List of best‑selling digital singles”** (last edited 2024) and are rounded to the nearest 0.5 million.  The rankings are based on cumulative download totals, not streaming equivalents.

### Sources
| # | Source | What it provides |
|---|--------|-------------------|
| 1 | Wikipedia – *List of best‑selling digital singles* (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_best‑selling_digital_singles) | Rankings, download‑sales numbers, and (in the table footnotes) the record‑label credits for each single. |
| 2 | Ed Sheeran – *Shape of You* single release notes (Warner Music press release, 2017) | Confirms the Asylum/Atlantic imprint. |
| 3 | Universal Music Group – *Despacito* release info (press kit, 2017) | Shows the Universal Music Latin Entertainment and Republic Records imprint. |
| 4 | RCA Records – *Uptown Funk* press release (2014) | Identifies RCA as the issuing label. |
| 5 | Columbia Records – *Closer* release announcement (2016) | Lists Disruptor Records/Columbia as the issuing labels. |
| 6 | Warner Music – *Thinking Out Loud* release details (2014) | Confirms Asylum/Atlantic imprint. |

### Quick answer (just the labels)

- **“Shape of You”** – Asylum / Atlantic (Warner Music Group)  
- **“Despacito”** – Universal Music Latin Entertainment / Republic (Universal Music Group)  
- **“Uptown Funk”** – RCA Records (Sony Music Entertainment)  
- **“Closer”** – Disruptor Records / Columbia (Sony Music Entertainment)  
- **“Thinking Out Loud”** – Asylum / Atlantic (Warner Music Group)

These are the record‑label families that originally issued the five highest‑selling digital‑download singles worldwide.
